candidates.sentence: No immigration reform will be effective until our border is secure, and that starts by enforcing the law, finishing the wall, and holding employers accountable.
It is my priority to continue working every day to pass common sense election integrity laws to ensure that every eligible Arkansan can vote and trust that vote will be counted.
I am taking action to curb inflation, secure our borders, defend our constitutional rights, and push back radical leftist agendas.
As your Senator, I have always stood up for voter ID laws and the security of our election system.
